'''Vorgrim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he served as a [[Prison/Legends|Prison]] Warden in [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where he was killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] seeking to free [[Phalanx (individual)|Phalanx]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prison Warden Vorgrim appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the heroic mission "Shadow Extraction" on Nar Shaddaa.
